turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Starting spindle diagnostic procedure.

ground_truth.node_text: Start

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Begin the warm up cycle. Run the spindle at 500 RPM for 5 minutes, then increase to 2000 RPM for another 5 minutes.

ground_truth.node_text: Warm up cycle, spindle at 500 revolutions per minute for 5 min, 2000 revolutions per minute for 5 min

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Warm up cycle complete. Spindle ran at 500 RPM for 5 minutes and then at 2000 RPM for 5 minutes.

ground_truth.node_text: Warm up cycle, spindle at 500 revolutions per minute for 5 min, 2000 revolutions per minute for 5 min

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Attach a triaxial accelerometer to the spindle nose with sensor axes aligned to machine X, Y, and Z. Run the spindle at 3000 RPM without a toolholder and record RMS vibration velocity in each axis. Repeat at maximum rated speed and compare all six readings against the baseline from previous service.

ground_truth.node_text: Attach a triaxial accelerometer to the spindle nose using a flat washer stud or epoxy mount with the sensor axes aligned to the machine X, Y, and Z axes. Run the spindle at 3000 revolutions per minute with no toolholder and record the root mean square vibration velocity in each axis. Repeat the measurement at the maximum rated speed and compare all six readings against the baseline vibration record from the previous service.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Accelerometer mounted and measurements taken at both speeds. All six readings recorded and compared to baseline.

ground_truth.node_text: Attach a triaxial accelerometer to the spindle nose using a flat washer stud or epoxy mount with the sensor axes aligned to the machine X, Y, and Z axes. Run the spindle at 3000 revolutions per minute with no toolholder and record the root mean square vibration velocity in each axis. Repeat the measurement at the maximum rated speed and compare all six readings against the baseline vibration record from the previous service.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the vibration level below the alarm threshold at warm up speed?

ground_truth.node_text: Vibration level below alarm threshold at warm up speed?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Yes, all vibration readings are below the alarm threshold at warm up speed.

ground_truth.node_text: Vibration level below alarm threshold at warm up speed?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the front bearing temperature within the rated limit after warm up?

ground_truth.node_text: Front bearing temperature within rated limit after warm up?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Yes, front bearing temperature is within the rated limit.

ground_truth.node_text: Front bearing temperature within rated limit after warm up?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the radial runout within 1 micrometer at the spindle nose?

ground_truth.node_text: Radial runout within 1 µm at spindle nose?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: No, the radial runout is reading 1.4 micrometers, which exceeds the specification.

ground_truth.node_text: Radial runout within 1 µm at spindle nose?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Adjust the front bearing preload in quarter turn increments on the locknut.

ground_truth.node_text: Adjust front bearing pre load, locknut quarter turn increments

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Bearing preload adjusted, locknut tightened in quarter turn increments.

ground_truth.node_text: Adjust front bearing pre load, locknut quarter turn increments

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Reverify the radial runout after the bearing preload adjustment.

ground_truth.node_text: Reverify radial runout after bearing pre load adjustment

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Runout has improved to 0.8 micrometers, now within specification.

ground_truth.node_text: Reverify radial runout after bearing pre load adjustment

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the axial play within the 2 micrometer limit?

ground_truth.node_text: Axial play within 2 µm limit?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Yes, axial play measures 1.6 micrometers, within the limit.

ground_truth.node_text: Axial play within 2 µm limit?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the taper contact pattern above 80% of the taper area?

ground_truth.node_text: Taper contact pattern above 80% of taper area?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: No, the contact pattern is showing only about 65% coverage with some patchy areas.

ground_truth.node_text: Taper contact pattern above 80% of taper area?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Clean the taper bore using a lint-free cloth, isopropyl alcohol, and compressed air.

ground_truth.node_text: Clean taper bore, lint free cloth, isopropyl alcohol, compressed air

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Taper bore cleaned thoroughly with alcohol and compressed air.

ground_truth.node_text: Clean taper bore, lint free cloth, isopropyl alcohol, compressed air

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Reverify the taper contact after cleaning the taper bore.

ground_truth.node_text: Reverify taper contact after taper bore cleaning

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Contact pattern has improved to 85% coverage, now acceptable.

ground_truth.node_text: Reverify taper contact after taper bore cleaning

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the drawbar retention force within the rated range?

ground_truth.node_text: Drawbar retention force within rated range?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Yes, retention force measured at 2850 newtons, within the specified range.

ground_truth.node_text: Drawbar retention force within rated range?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the speed accuracy within plus or minus 0.1% at all four test speeds?

ground_truth.node_text: Speed accuracy within ±0.1% at all four test speeds?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Yes, all four test speeds are within 0.1% accuracy.

ground_truth.node_text: Speed accuracy within ±0.1% at all four test speeds?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the vibration within the warning limit at full rated speed?

ground_truth.node_text: Vibration within warning limit at full rated speed?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: No, vibration levels are elevated at full speed, exceeding the warning limit in the Y axis.

ground_truth.node_text: Vibration within warning limit at full rated speed?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Complete the following checks: reduce spindle speed to 50% rated and monitor vibration for two minutes, check whether vibration reduces at lower speed to indicate a balance issue, and inspect the spindle nose and toolholder taper for contamination or damage.

ground_truth.node_text: Complete the following checks: 1. Reduce spindle speed to 50% rated and monitor vibration for two minutes. 2. Check whether vibration reduces at lower speed to indicate a balance issue. 3. Inspect the spindle nose and toolholder taper for contamination or damage.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Checks completed. Vibration reduced at 50% speed and found minor contamination on the toolholder taper.

ground_truth.node_text: Complete the following checks: 1. Reduce spindle speed to 50% rated and monitor vibration for two minutes. 2. Check whether vibration reduces at lower speed to indicate a balance issue. 3. Inspect the spindle nose and toolholder taper for contamination or damage.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Mount a dial test indicator against a precision reference mandrel in the spindle. Zero the indicator as the cold datum, then run the spindle at operating speed for 30 minutes. Record the indicator position at five minute intervals and note the total thermal displacement at stabilization.

ground_truth.node_text: Mount a dial test indicator against a precision reference mandrel clamped in the spindle before starting the warm up cycle. Zero the indicator and record the position as the cold datum. Run the spindle at operating speed for 30 minutes and record the indicator position at five minute intervals. Note the total thermal displacement at stabilisation and compare against the thermal growth compensation value stored in the machine thermal model parameters.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Thermal growth measurement complete. Total displacement recorded at stabilization.

ground_truth.node_text: Mount a dial test indicator against a precision reference mandrel clamped in the spindle before starting the warm up cycle. Zero the indicator and record the position as the cold datum. Run the spindle at operating speed for 30 minutes and record the indicator position at five minute intervals. Note the total thermal displacement at stabilisation and compare against the thermal growth compensation value stored in the machine thermal model parameters.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the thermal growth within the compensation model plus or minus 3 micrometers?

ground_truth.node_text: Thermal growth within compensation model ±3 µm?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: No, thermal growth is measuring 5.2 micrometers, outside the compensation model tolerance.

ground_truth.node_text: Thermal growth within compensation model ±3 µm?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Access the thermal growth model parameter screen in the machine controller. Read the current growth coefficient and reference temperature for the Z axis, then compare the stored values against the reference values from the last calibration.

ground_truth.node_text: Complete the following steps: 1. Access the thermal growth model parameter screen in the machine controller. 2. Read the current growth coefficient and reference temperature for the Z axis. 3. Compare the stored values against the reference values from the last calibration.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Parameters accessed and compared. Values reviewed against last calibration data.

ground_truth.node_text: Complete the following steps: 1. Access the thermal growth model parameter screen in the machine controller. 2. Read the current growth coefficient and reference temperature for the Z axis. 3. Compare the stored values against the reference values from the last calibration.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Command the spindle orientation to 0 degrees and measure the angular error. Then command orientation to 90, 180, and 270 degrees, measuring the angular error at each position.

ground_truth.node_text: Command the spindle orientation to the 0 degree reference position from the machine control panel. Mount a precision angular encoder or a dial test indicator on an arm at a known radius and measure the angular error relative to the reference mark. Command orientation to 90, 180, and 270 degrees and measure the angular error at each position; compare all four readings against the spindle orientation accuracy specification.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Spindle orientation checked at all four positions. Angular errors recorded.

ground_truth.node_text: Command the spindle orientation to the 0 degree reference position from the machine control panel. Mount a precision angular encoder or a dial test indicator on an arm at a known radius and measure the angular error relative to the reference mark. Command orientation to 90, 180, and 270 degrees and measure the angular error at each position; compare all four readings against the spindle orientation accuracy specification.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the spindle orientation within plus or minus 0.001 degrees of the commanded angle?

ground_truth.node_text: Spindle orientation within ±0.001° of commanded angle?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Yes, all four orientation positions are within 0.001 degrees of commanded angles.

ground_truth.node_text: Spindle orientation within ±0.001° of commanded angle?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Are the coolant flow and pressure at the spindle taper within specification?

ground_truth.node_text: Coolant flow and pressure at spindle taper within specification?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: No, pressure is reading low at 18 bar and flow appears slightly pulsing.

ground_truth.node_text: Coolant flow and pressure at spindle taper within specification?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Stop coolant flow and inspect the rotary union seal face for scoring. Check the rotary union body for coolant leakage tracks or deposits, and inspect the inlet and outlet port fittings for leakage or cross threading.

ground_truth.node_text: Complete the following checks: 1. Stop coolant flow and inspect the rotary union seal face for scoring. 2. Check the rotary union body for coolant leakage tracks or deposits. 3. Inspect the inlet and outlet port fittings for leakage or cross threading.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Inspection complete. Found minor scoring on the seal face and some deposits on the union body.

ground_truth.node_text: Complete the following checks: 1. Stop coolant flow and inspect the rotary union seal face for scoring. 2. Check the rotary union body for coolant leakage tracks or deposits. 3. Inspect the inlet and outlet port fittings for leakage or cross threading.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Load the test piece material into the machine work holding and run the standard spindle test machining program. After machining, measure bore diameter at three depths and face flatness at four points.

ground_truth.node_text: Load the test piece material, typically a 100 millimetre diameter aluminium or cast iron disc, into the machine work holding and run the standard spindle test machining program. The program bores a 50 millimetre diameter hole and faces the top surface. After machining, measure bore diameter at three depths and face flatness at four points using a coordinate measuring machine or precision gauges. Compare all results against the machined geometry tolerances in the spindle acceptance test plan.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Test piece machined and measurements taken. All bore and flatness measurements recorded.

ground_truth.node_text: Load the test piece material, typically a 100 millimetre diameter aluminium or cast iron disc, into the machine work holding and run the standard spindle test machining program. The program bores a 50 millimetre diameter hole and faces the top surface. After machining, measure bore diameter at three depths and face flatness at four points using a coordinate measuring machine or precision gauges. Compare all results against the machined geometry tolerances in the spindle acceptance test plan.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the test piece geometry within drawing tolerance?

ground_truth.node_text: Test piece geometry within drawing tolerance?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Yes, all measurements are within the drawing tolerance.

ground_truth.node_text: Test piece geometry within drawing tolerance?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Log all spindle measurements and update the maintenance record.

ground_truth.node_text: Log all spindle measurements and update maintenance record

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: All measurements logged and maintenance record updated.

ground_truth.node_text: Log all spindle measurements and update maintenance record

turns.utterance: Spindle diagnostic procedure complete. Return the spindle to production status.

turns.utterance: Understood, procedure complete.
